data.name: Dinabandhu
data.gender_notes: Dinabandhu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Day giver, friend of the day
data.long_meaning: Dinabandhu is a name derived from Sanskrit roots 'dina' meaning 'day' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend'. This name symbolizes one who is a giver of days, a friend to all on the daily basis. The name Dinabandhu carries the meaning “Day giver, friend of the day” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dinabandhu usually hope their child will grow to embody day giver, friend of the day and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Brings the energy of the sun and positivity
data.etymology: Dinabandhu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Day giver, friend of the day.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dinabandhu total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This name holds significance in the relationships we build and strengthen daily, as a Dinabandhu is seen as a constant companion and supporter.
